name: Yathin Ajay Kumar khotwani A
ambition: I want to become the best web developer—combining deep architectural understanding with the velocity of AI-native workflows.
shortBio: I build at the speed of thought. I am deeply interested in the art of vibe coding—leveraging AI, intuition, and flow state to bypass boilerplate and ship prototypes lightning-fast. For me, hackathons are about focusing on the user experience and turning raw ideas into deployed reality before the momentum fades.
aboutStory: Born and raised in Tamil Nadu, my fascination with the web started with a simple question: why does turning a clear visual idea into a working web application take weeks of repetitive setup?

That curiosity led me to the art of Vibe Coding—an inquisitive, flow-state approach to software creation where human intuition directs AI models (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Studio) to handle boilerplate while I focus relentlessly on user experience, typography, motion, and real product value.

Whether in high-pressure hackathons or solo late-night builds, I use AI not as a shortcut around learning, but as an interactive mentor and accelerator. Every generated module is something I inspect, comment, and refine—because my ultimate goal is to become the best web developer I can possibly be.

vibePhilosophy.title: Research & Prompt Architecture First
vibePhilosophy.description: Great vibe coding starts before a single line of code is generated. I use Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini to dissect the problem, structure clean data models, and write crystal-clear build prompts.

vibePhilosophy.title: Ship Before Momentum Fades
vibePhilosophy.description: In hackathons and rapid prototyping, creative energy is perishable. By bypassing repetitive setup in Google AI Studio, I keep the idea alive and testable in a real browser within minutes.

vibePhilosophy.title: Read, Comment & Master the Code
vibePhilosophy.description: Vibe coding is how I learn faster. By demanding clean, semantic HTML, modular JavaScript/TypeScript, and commented logic, every prototype makes me a stronger engineer.
